## Description:
Add climate device triggers.

Also fixed typo in constant `ATTR_HVAC_ACTIONS`  -> `ATTR_HVAC_ACTION`

I wanted to also include HVAC action but it was not possible to write an automation that tracks an attribute changing to/from a specific value.

I also realized that the state trigger is annoying in that you need to specify all values for the `from` to prevent it from firing on attribute changes 🤷‍♂ 

**Related issue (if applicable):** fixes #27014

issue_context.title: Add device trigger support to the climate integration
issue_context.body:
Add [device trigger](https://developers.home-assistant.io/docs/en/device_automation_trigger.html) support to the climate integration.

Device triggers are part of [Device Automations](https://developers.home-assistant.io/docs/en/device_automation_index.html), a new concept that was [recently launched](https://www.home-assistant.io/blog/2019/09/18/release-99/#device-automations) to make automations more user friendly.

Device automations consist of three different parts: triggers, conditions and actions. This issue is about the trigger part.

To get started with this issue, you will need to set up a Home Assistant development environment. The easiest approach is to get started using [a dev container](https://developers.home-assistant.io/docs/en/development_environment.html#developing-with-devcontainer).

Once you have a development environment set up, run the following and follow the instructions:

```python
python3 -m script.scaffold device_trigger
```

_(This issue is part of #27008)_
